verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional documents per-message webhook events for hard-bounce, soft-bounce, spam (complaint) and reject. That gives a programmatic consumer bounce and complaint signals per send. The marketing reporting evidence covers only opens and clicks. Nothing shows blocklist signals or deliverability-degradation guidance. missing for 10: marketer-facing per-send bounce/complaint reporting, blocklist monitoring signals, actionable guidance when deliverability degrades, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades

citations.quote: **Message events**: send, deferral, hard-bounce, soft-bounce, delivered, open, click, spam, unsub, reject
Webhooks allow your application to receive information about email events as they occur and respond in a way that you define.
